data.name: Halimun
data.gender_notes: Halimun is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: A person who is gentle, kind, and friendly, and maintains good relationships with others. The name Halimun carries the meaning “Friendly, kind” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic. Parents who choose Halimun usually hope their child will grow to embody friendly, kind and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes the ability to maintain peace and harmony in relationships, and to be a good friend.
data.etymology: Halimun belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Friendly, kind.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Halimun total 6, giving a life-path number of 6. Number 6 is linked with Venus and with the qualities of responsibility, care and community.

in_arabic.name: حليمون
in_arabic.long_meaning: الحليمون: اسم من أسماء الله الحسنى، يصف صفة الله تعالى بالحلم والسماحة والتسامح، ويُستخدم للإشارة إلى شخص يملك هذه الصفات. يرتبط هذا الاسم ارتباطًا وثيقًا بالتركيب اللغوي الحليم-ون، والذي يعني الحلم والتسامح والحنون. يعد هذا الاسم من أسماء الله الحسنى، ويتكرر في القرآن الكريم كصفة تعالى لله، ويُستخدم للإشارة إلى السلوك العادل والمنصف في الإسلام.

in_urdu.name: حلیمون
